candidate.title: Discrete-Time Almgren-Chriss Liquidation Execution for USDJPY
candidate.target_phenomenon: Execution slippage under transient price impact
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Pre-scheduled liquidation of inventory X_0 across K discrete steps minimizing execution cost and volatility risk.
candidate.claim: Following the discrete trajectory x_k reduces total execution slippage compared to naive uniform TWAP.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Grounded in optimal liquidation theory balancing temporary impact against variance.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Total execution cost fails to achieve 15% reduction vs TWAP with p < 0.05 over 6-month out-of-sample test.

backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Historical volatility and estimated transient impact decay parameter rho from trade execution logs.
backtest_spec.entry_condition: Initiate planned liquidation of X_0 lots upon receiving parent rebalancing order.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Cease liquidation when remaining inventory x_k reaches 0 or execute remaining lots as market order at terminal step K.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Max participation rate capped at 10% of 5-minute bar volume.

candidate.title: Hawkes Endogenous Cascade Volatility Filter for USDJPY
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Calibrating multivariate Hawkes branching ratio from tick-level event stream and aggregating intensity to M5 intervals.

candidate.grounding_rationale: Hawkes processes quantify endogenous self-excitation in trade and quote arrivals.

backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Intraday proxy of Hawkes conditional intensity lambda(t) computed from tick event stream arrivals.
backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter momentum trade only when Hawkes branching ratio Gamma < 0.80 and price trend > 20 pips.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit trade when branching ratio Gamma exceeds 0.95 or 30-minute time-stop triggers.

candidate.title: Regime-Filtered Jump Risk Sizing for USDJPY
candidate.target_phenomenon: Currency rate jump clustering during crisis regimes
candidate.proposed_mechanism: Estimating regime-switching jump diffusion parameters via Hamilton filter on M5 log-returns.
candidate.claim: Filtering latent crisis regime probability P(s_t = crisis | F_t) allows dynamic position sizing that mitigates jump tail risk.
candidate.grounding_rationale: Jump diffusion models separate continuous Gaussian diffusion from discrete compound Poisson jumps across Markov regimes.
candidate.testable_falsification_condition: Conditional value-at-risk (CVaR 99%) fails to improve by 15% vs unscaled baseline over 6 months.

backtest_spec.feature_engineering: Posterior crisis regime probability P(s_t = crisis | F_t) and filtered jump intensity lambda_crisis from log-returns.
backtest_spec.entry_condition: Enter baseline carry trade when P(s_t = calm | F_t) > 0.80 and scale size down to 0 when P(s_t = crisis | F_t) > 0.60.
backtest_spec.exit_condition: Exit all positions immediately if filtered jump intensity lambda_crisis exceeds 90th percentile.
backtest_spec.risk_management: Position size inversely proportional to filtered regime jump variance.
